question.text: Methylene blue, from its aqueous solution, is adsorbed on activated charcoal at 25<sup>o</sup><sup> </sup>C. For this process, the correct statement is

options.text: The adsorption is accompanied by a decrease in enthalpy
The adsorption increases with increase of temperature.

solution.text:
It is the process of Physical adsorption as charcoal is already activated.
Since physical adsorption is spontaneous  Δ G  is -ve
Δ G = Δ H - T Δ S
as Δ S  is -ve (passage of methylene blue from aqueous phase over the surface of adsorbent) i.e. Δ H  is highly -ve since process is exothermic in nature.

Physical adsorption is reversible in nature.

Physical adsorption decreases with increase in temperature.
